why_owner: Publication approval, and an institutional-voice question. Between the eight negative-evidence types (what the archive did not produce) and 05-HOLDS/ (what cannot be reached) there is nothing for what we could do and have not done - and "NOT ATTEMPTED" was struck down under review as an invented ninth type. Whether the research queue gets a public face is not derivable from any retrieval. Inherited standing rule 12 types such a page INCOMPLETE and stops there.
notes: The concrete instance is IH-287, INHERITED-UNVERIFIED, handoff work item 19: "The varna 23 human-applied split and the colour/skin count done right are owed." Recorded as owed before this repository existed and still open; VAR-008, VERIFIED, records that the sense sort published on what-varna-meant.html is that owed work. Framework §11.1's negative rows are the nearest existing fit and are attached to Reconnection alone, and they are obligations to third parties rather than to the record. BF-022 is the argument against the permissive answer: displaying owed work is honest, but staging it converts a failure into an asset. ADDED 2026-09-08 after independent review: inherited standing rule 12 (IH-347, INHERITED-UNVERIFIED) already supplies a disposition for the underlying problem - "A search named as owed is a dependency; a page depending on it is INCOMPLETE" - and rev. 1 of the specification did not mention it. It does not close this decision, because rule 12 types the page's STATE and says nothing about what the page may DISPLAY, but any answer here should say why it is not enough.
